contextOfUse: Characterize FlowLab's selected laminar OpenFOAM implementation for predeclared FDA nozzle Re=500 velocity and offset-free pressure quantities. This is not validation of general CFD, arbitrary geometry, medical-device performance, turbulence, or external product readiness.

problemStatement.retainedOutcome: The completed v2 recovery r3 campaign is validated-blocked with promotionAuthorized=false.
problemStatement.historicalNinetyPercentRule: Retained only for transparent reproduction of v2. It is a FlowLab campaign policy, not an FDA or ASME universal acceptance threshold, and is not a successor promotion gate until independently calibrated.

evidence: full-rank tap covariance or enough independent traces to estimate it
referencePressurePromotionReady.onFailure: Keep pressure nonpromotional and block the full successor campaign.

evidence: one immutable analytic or CAD geometric model shared by all grids
prospectively declared geometry-discretization tolerance and analytic domain-measure audit
explicit separation or bounded propagation of geometry and solution discretization
three grids minimum; add a fourth when three-grid convergence is unqualified
mesh quality and exact refinement records
successorGridFamilyPreflightComplete.onFailure: Do not launch the successor solver matrix or describe GCI as isolating solution discretization.

stages.stopGo: Stop unless source hashes, eligibility, uncertainty construction, laboratory mapping, and covariance sufficiency are reproducible.

stages.authorization: new diagnostic directory only after stage A permits the affected QoIs
stages.stopGo: Stop unless predeclared residual and QoI-drift thresholds pass without changing solver physics or frozen r3 evidence.

stages.authorization: new mesh-only preflight before solver execution
stages.stopGo: Stop unless geometry discretization is prospectively bounded or separately propagated; use classical GCI only where asymptotic convergence is qualified, otherwise add a grid or use a prospectively selected estimator.
Run an independent solver and prospectively bounded as-built, inlet, and tap sensitivities; never tune against observed validation failures.

successorAcceptanceDesign.criticalQuantities: Every critical quantity requires resolved numerical uncertainty; no aggregate pass rate may hide an unqualified critical point.
successorAcceptanceDesign.denseProfiles: Use predeclared station/region functionals, correlation-aware global error, maximum standardized exceedance, and contiguous-exceedance diagnostics rather than treating hundreds of correlated samples as independent votes.
successorAcceptanceDesign.pointwiseVv20: Retain pointwise E and U_val characterization. Do not represent ASME V&V 20 as prescribing a universal campaign pass fraction.
successorAcceptanceDesign.promotion: Requires every prospectively frozen gate true in a later full-campaign contract and a digest-checked final assessment with promotionAuthorized=true.

nextAuthorizedWork: Run the read-only successor preflight against retained r3 evidence.
Acquire or document the missing pressure-reference provenance; otherwise reclassify pressure as nonpromotional.
Design and mesh-preflight a grid family with prospectively bounded geometry discretization in a new output directory.
Do not launch a full CFD campaign until both preflight blockers are cleared.
